name: Caz'iunes the Executioner

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Attack
abilities.description: A charged melee attack dealing moderate-high physical damage and staggering. This can be blocked to stagger Caz'iunes instead.

abilities.name: Wild Swings
abilities.description: Caz'iunes swings his weapon side-to-side three times, as indicated by a red cone. All swings deal low physical damage and snare but the third also knocks back. This can be blocked to change the knockback into a stagger.

abilities.name: Driving Strike
abilities.description: Every 20% Health, Caz'iunes spins around and slams his weapon into the ground, indicated by a slowly growing red circle, which sends a burst of deep red energy shooting forward rapidly, with the circle now following. Getting hit deals moderate-high magic damage and knocks down. This can be blocked to negate the knockdown.

summary: Caz'iunes the Executioner is a Dremora who can be found in the upper tier of the entry room, past All-Seeing Ky'zuu. He serves as one of the champions of the Underweave.
